profile.name: 索雷博APT运动与压电控制器
profile.name_en: Thorlabs APT Motion and Piezo Controller
profile.description: 基于APT通信协议的索雷博多通道硬件控制器，用于驱动电机位移台、旋转台、压电台和压电惯性执行器等运动设备。可进行设备识别、通道管理、回零、绝对与相对运动、点动运动，以及位置和控制参数读取与设置。
profile.description_en: A Thorlabs multi-channel hardware controller using the APT communication protocol to drive motion devices such as motorized stages, rotation stages, piezo stages, and piezo inertia actuators. It supports device identification, channel management, homing, absolute and relative moves, jog motion, and reading or setting position and control parameters.
